body.heading: Choose your words
paragraphs: Pick words you love: puddle, giggle, breakfast, dragon. Words you like saying are the best ones.
Write one word at the top of each page, with help if you need it.

body.heading: Draw each word
paragraphs: Draw a picture that shows what the word means. A puddle with a boot splashing in it says puddle perfectly.
Read your dictionary to your family. You are the author.

takeaway: A dictionary you make yourself, with your own pictures, is a book about your world.
safetyNotes: An adult helps fold and staple or tie the booklet.
screenFreeExtension: Add one new word to your dictionary every day for a week.
